title: docs(pm-dispatch): area-lease mode for any lane — dynamic areas, review seats, land after PASS
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQCDo95V93TcG8DWzACJem5)_

Fixes #33751

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 技能新增「区域租约模式」参考文档(`references/area-lease.md`),任一车道都可按需启用;`seat-lifecycle.md` 加一行换号移座规则;`SKILL.md` 阶段细则索引加一行指向它。
- 为什么改:server 车道区域租约试点约 18 小时关 117 张卡,您要求立卡写进技能并推广到其他车道,且分不分区、怎么分由席位动态决定。
- 风险与回滚:只改席位读的规则文本,不碰产品代码与已发布包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`(全文 60 行),其次 `seat-lifecycle.md` 新增的「移座」一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期三处新读数为 SKILL.md 320/320、seat-lifecycle.md 100/100、area-lease.md 60/60,全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,达档契约复审 PASS 后由席位经队列落地)。

## What changes

- **New `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`** (60 lines, lane-neutral). Card §3 maps to it as follows:
  - §2.2 dynamic partitioning: the seat re-decides whether to split, how many areas and their boundaries at seating and at every hand-over or shift; the split threshold (≥15 claimable p1/p2 across ≥3 independent module clusters) is stated as a rule of thumb; areas merge when drained and split when backed up; the lease table lives on the seat post; review seats scale at about one per three active areas and sit on another account (`lanes/review.md` independence) unless the maintainer's own word in the thread says otherwise; queue duty is a pure pointer to `lanes/queue.md`, its no-seat fallback included. The 2026-11-14 server split appears only as a worked example, with a line saying other lanes derive their own.
  - §2.3 startup, including the maintainer's authorising line in each new thread (both lines quoted verbatim from the card) and W0 (grading per SKILL.md 域车道 and `triage-duties.md`, closing per `execution-duties.md`, never on an area's own reading).
  - Area sessions sign with the seat signature and put their own session in `Session:`; claims by sessions on the lease table do not count as the stand-down reading three of `seat-lifecycle.md`.
  - §2.4 rules, written as pointers to the reference that owns each rule: claim (`execution-duties.md` atomic pair plus the `lease:` label), review routing, who is knocked and head moves (`contract-review.md`), landing (`landing-operations.md`, SKILL.md 路径分叉), folding (`execution-duties.md` five gates), front-jump (`landing-operations.md`), escalation (SKILL.md 升级与决策), security (`security-findings.md`), context rotation (`seat-lifecycle.md`). Development-time code reading goes to sub-agents; the seat thread reads no diffs or logs except the ACCEPT self-read `contract-review.md` and SKILL.md 路径分叉 require.
  - The Tier H four-piece hand-off re-check every round: the seat re-checks every PASS'd governed PR each round, the areas' hand-offs included, through `execution-duties.md`'s existing four-piece line (not restated).
  - The mailbox-on-every-seating rule (lesson 2): never dropped, a new mailbox on every re-seating, account change or seat move.
  - The cross-account hand-over (lesson 3) and ownership split (lesson 4): the hand-over and each area's state go into a seat-post comment, never only into project files or memory.
  - Lesson 5 (perf numbers only from the reviewed bench PR) and lesson 6 (read labels back after a claim) each get one line.
- **`seat-lifecycle.md`** gains one line, 移座: an outgoing account still draining moves to a free seat with its own mailbox, the original seat post carries the ownership split, and it comments `ownership transferred` when done.
- **`SKILL.md`** gains one 阶段细则索引 row naming the new reference and its reader. That row is also the single lane-wide line saying the mode is open to any lane past the split threshold, which is cheaper than one line in each of the 15 `lanes/*.md` files, as the order prefers.
- **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: new `CEILINGS` row (area-lease.md, 60, headroom 0) and `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row (0); two ordinary ruled raises, each with its CEILINGS comment:
  - `SKILL.md` 319 → 320, measured delta +1.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md` 99 → 100, measured delta +1.
  - Ruling of record for both: the maintainer's words quoted verbatim in the body of #33751 (filing gate ③): 「然后应该立卡更新skills。这种方式适合推广到其他车道吗？」 · 「所以是否分区域，如何分区域应该是动态的是吗？」 · 「你直接立卡，然后让 server 5 按照你的卡处理也可以」; claim comment 6892768967.

Not touched, per the order: `contract-review.md`, `filing-gate.md`, `triage-duties.md`, `landing-operations.md`, `lanes/queue.md`, and every `lanes/*.md`.

## Review fixes (contract review 6893242470 at `b741f825`)

Head `8f2ea546`, all in `area-lease.md`, paid in place (60 lines, headroom 0, no further raise) by compressing the worked example from six lines to four and folding its "other lanes derive their own" line into its lead:
- S1: queue duty is a pure pointer to `lanes/queue.md`, fallback included.
- S2: review seats sit on another account, or on the same account only on the maintainer's own word in that thread; the send line points at `contract-review.md` for whether, whom and at which tier, and no longer names an area review seat.
- S3: the no-diff rule names the seat thread and excepts the ACCEPT self-read; the sub-agent rule says development-time reading.
- S4: area sessions carry the seat signature with their own `Session:`, and lease-table sessions' claims do not count as stand-down reading three.
- N1 pilot residue dropped; N2 the usage line goes in a seat-post comment; N4 解读 ADR; N5 closing points at `execution-duties.md`. N3 (`lease:` labels in `ensure-pm-labels.sh`) left for the seat's follow-up card.

## Review fixes, round 2 (delta review 6893494266 at `8f2ea546`)

Head `0d547f0d`, which also merges `origin/main` (clean merge; main had moved `lanes/queue.md`, `landing-operations.md` and the ratchet script). Zero net lines, no ceiling row moved:
- S5 and S6: the stand-down exemption now lives with its owner. `seat-lifecycle.md`'s existing exemption line says the current PM session and the sessions on its lease table don't count against each other in readings three (push limb included) and four. Any other reader, such as a duplicate fire, a wall recovery or a new account during overlap, still counts them. `area-lease.md` points at it instead of carrying its own reading-three exemption.
- N9: A5 excepts action routes again, so A5 and E2b don't overlap. N10: the lease table names thread sessions and is rewritten when a thread rotates.

## Tests

Text-only change to the PM skill plus two ratchet rows; no package is touched, so there is no build closure or package test. The ratchet script's own self-test was run (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 164 cases pass).

## Acceptance notes

Three card §2.4 items were deliberately not written into the skill, because each belongs to a reference this order keeps closed, or would conflict with a rule that outranks it:
- **"A clean main merge (same patch-id) keeps the PASS."** The head-move rule is owned by `contract-review.md` (only a pure regeneration or a prose-only move carries the record), and the queue guard reads a current-head record. Adding a patch-id carry needs that file. The new reference points at it.
- **"A seat ruling that changes observable behaviour or interprets an ADR gets one independent review first."** SKILL.md's red line says seats only analyse and recommend and every ruling is human. So the reference lets the seat decide routing only (split, fold, defer, area) and sends behaviour or ADR readings through 升级与决策.
- **Branch names `claude/area-ID-CARD`.** AGENTS.md names branches `claude/issue-N-SLUG` (and its force-push criterion ① reads that prefix), and AGENTS.md wins over `.claude/**`. So the claim's `Branch:` follows AGENTS.md, and the area id travels on the `lease:` label and the lease table.

Also out of scope: the pre-push "touched packages plus dependents" test rule (os-dev.md owns local verification scope), merge-queue build counts (queue configuration is the maintainer's per `lanes/queue.md`), and the `lease:*` label family, which is not in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`'s vocabulary (labels are created on first write; the new reference is their named reader).

## Verification

Readings on head `0d547f0d` (tier and register readings unchanged from `b741f825`; size now +89 / -3 against the new merge base):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "Model tier — MANDATORY" at the contract-review tier, triggered by `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (clause ①). The SKILL.md edit is one index row; the reference text is under `references/**`, which the path mandate does not cover. Written at the default tier under the one-line-class exit, compensated by the at-tier contract review the seat routes. Changed lines 90, under the 3000 threshold.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-g5qfeh`: **GOVERNED — Tier S** (席内达档复核落地), `.claude/**` ×3; `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not on the register.
